mapper.select: SELECT st.id, st.code, st.source_code, st.source_id, st.approve_status, st.create_time, st.update_user_name, sp.mode AS stocktakingMode, sp.type AS stocktakingType, sp.status AS stocktakingStatus, sp.separate_rule AS separateRule FROM stocktaking_task st LEFT JOIN stocktaking_plan sp ON st.source_id=sp.id AND sp.is_deleted=FALSE WHERE st.is_deleted=FALSE AND st.id=#{id}
